rules.alternatives: The Colorado Medical Board rules set no general CME hour requirement for physician assistant renewal (Rule 1.33 CME applies to physicians only); only the substance use prevention training below.
rules.audit_note: Attest at renewal, reactivation or reinstatement; the board may audit and request documentation of the training or exemption.

topics.who: All physicians and PAs unless exempt under C.R.S. 12-30-114(1)(b); training may include CE, self-study, conferences, teaching, peer review

rules.notes: Rule 1.29: 2 cumulative hours of substance use prevention/treatment training per renewal period. A repeal of Rule 1.29 was proposed in 2026 but the current version (eff. 07/15/2026) still contains it. Renewal period length not stated in the rules read.
